title: Simulation with blank auxiliary tapes
statement: Let $m,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a type, let $M$ be a $m$-work-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with states in $S$, and let $bank$ be an injection from the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices. For every state $q\in S$, Boolean input word $x$, and time $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the machine obtained by embedding $M$ into the $k$-tape machine, from the configuration with state $q$ and all tapes blank, gives the same configuration as embedding the configuration reached by running $M$ for $t$ steps from that all-blank configuration; the additional tapes are blank, their heads are at zero, and the output is unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean-alphabet Turing machine with $m$ work tapes and states in $S$
$bank$ injects the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
